decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service is distant from the firm's maritime crewing and management knowledge, making early results hard to interpret and learn from.
The superyacht crew recruitment service builds directly on the firm's existing crew placement and compliance capabilities, allowing the firm to learn and improve it.
The maritime education programme leverages the firm's established training centres and has quickly built a partner network, showing it can be assimilated and extended.
The emissions monitoring and compliance service is close to existing technical and regulatory work, and its successful FuelEU submissions show the firm can interpret and build on early results.
The emissions compliance dashboard builds on the firm's ship management software and environmental expertise, enabling learning and commercial improvement.
The emissions compliance cost simulation tool is integrated into the firm's established PAL software and draws on related environmental knowledge, so the firm can absorb and refine it.
